text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though Vivlos missed out on the Oka Sho, 
she managed a brilliant victory in the 
Oaks. The crowd now looks forward to her 
claiming two crowns.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To live up to those cheers, Vivlos asked 
her Trainer for another way to build 
confidence alongside the summer training 
camp.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aiming for even greater heights, Vivlos 
and her Trainer set their next sights on 
the Shion Stakes.
